about: React Native's networking on OxyOS (network.h, sample/NetworkProbe.tsx): fetch and XMLHttpRequest against a local server regress.py runs ("http"), with JSON, text, status, headers, a POST body, a redirect, bytes as an ArrayBuffer (a blob read back), a multipart form, an abort, a timeout and a text body as it arrives, a character split between two reads. A multipart form's file is read from the scenario's home through the file service (docs/adr/0028-file-access.mdx); one outside the home is refused, visibly. A refused connection fails as on Android.

texts: fetch text: ok plain text from the server
fetch post: ok POST text/plain hola
fetch form: ok POST multipart/form-data name=OxyOS
fetch form file: ok POST multipart/form-data file=a file from the home
fetch form outside: failed: Network request failed
fetch refused: failed: Network request failed
